name: Predict Binding Affinity Protein 1D Sequence
description: Predicts binding affinity between small molecules and a protein sequence using pre-trained deep learning models.
detailed_description: Predicts binding affinity between small molecules and a protein sequence using pre-trained deep learning models.
when_to_use: When you need predict binding affinity protein 1d sequence analysis

parameters.smiles_list: [Required] List of SMILES strings representing chemical compounds (List[str])
parameters.amino_acid_sequence: [Required] Protein sequence in amino acid format (str)
parameters.affinity_model_type: [Optional] Deep learning model architecture to use for binding affinity prediction (options: CNN-CNN, MPNN-CNN, Morgan-CNN, Morgan-AAC, Daylight-AAC) (default: MPNN-CNN)
